title: Risk of transmission of amyloid β pathology via transfused blood products
summary: This Lancet article examines the potential risk of transmitting amyloid β pathology (the protein aggregates associated with Alzheimer's disease) through blood transfusions and blood products, contributing to ongoing discussions about transfusion safety and blood donation policies.
problem_solved: Addresses whether amyloid β proteins can be iatrogenically transmitted via blood transfusions, raising important questions about blood supply safety and screening protocols.
why_valuable: Findings could influence global blood donation guidelines and transfusion practices, potentially affecting millions of patients requiring blood products annually.
